title: Find Your Nature Vibe: Which Allbirds Pair Matches Your Outdoor Style?
summary: Find the perfect Allbirds shoe to pair with your unique nature vibe—from desert hikers and urban explorers to mountain lovers and more.
body_markdown:
## The Urban Naturist


You appreciate nature, but in small, easily accessible doses—like a well-tended city park or a tree-lined avenue. Maybe you’ve got a[morning routine](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/how-to-stay-consistent-with-your-walking-routine) that includes a brisk walk around the neighborhood, or you make the most of the local botanic gardens on weekends. Concrete, meet canopies: you find green in your gray and love every second of that city-meets-nature vibe. **Best Shoe for the Urban Walker:**[Tree Runner Go](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-runner-go) For the urban explorer, comfort and style go hand in hand. The Tree Runner Go is light, breathable, and streamlined—exactly what you need to navigate sidewalks, public transit, or lunch-break strolls. With a modern silhouette and flexible design, these shoes meld effortlessly with your day-to-day wardrobe while offering the same cushioned, sustainable feel you expect from Allbirds. Natural chic in the big city, indeed.


## The Plains Dweller


Rolling grasslands, endless skies, and a horizon that seems to stretch on forever—if you find your bliss among open fields and gentle breezes, you’re a Plains Dweller at heart. Strolling through tall grasses as you watch the clouds drift by is your idea of zen. The weather can shift quickly, but you’re used to it and love the sense of space that comes from seeing for miles and miles at all angles. **Best Shoe for Open-Space Naturalists:**[Runner-Up Protects](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-runner-up-protect) Life on the plains can get windy, and sometimes that wind carries a bit of dust (and plenty of chill in the winter). The Runner-Up Protects give you a bit of extra coverage, thanks to the classic high-top design. You’ll still enjoy that soft, cozy fit with a shield from the elements—perfect for those wide-open spaces where the breeze roams as freely as you do. And when those random spring and summer showers inevitably pop up, you’ll have extra appreciation for their water-repellent shield and breathable water-resistant membrane.


## Mountain Folk


If your soul starts singing at the sight of a towering peak, rushing waterfalls, and crisp alpine air, you’re definitely part of the mountain folk. You relish the thought of exploring winding trails that reach panoramic summits and don’t mind a bit of elevation in your workout. (Okay, a lot of elevation.) **Best Shoe for the Elevation Fans:**[Wool Runner-Up Mizzles Plus](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner-up-mizzle-plus) High elevations often come with variable weather and the occasional shallow stream crossing. That’s where the Wool Runner-Up Mizzles Plus steps up. With added water-repellency and a slightly taller profile, these shoes give you extra protection from chilly splashes. The cozy wool blend upper keeps you warm when temperatures dip, yet it remains breathable enough to handle those invigorating uphill climbs.Nature has many faces, and we each connect with it in our own way. Whether your perfect backdrop is a dusty desert horizon, an ocean-side golf green, a hidden forest path, a bustling city park, a rolling field of grass, or a majestic mountain range, there’s an Allbirds shoe built to suit your favorite environment.So, what’s your vibe? Lace up the pair that speaks to you and step out. You just might discover that the[perfect escape](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/outdoor-shoes-for-the-nature-lover) lies right outside your front door—no matter where you call home.
